result.reason: The redline adds the professional-and-workmanlike warranty, fallback software and Services durations, and all three stated remedies. It does not meet the preferred durations. It also omits express coverage of service deliverables, compliance with laws, and absence of malicious code, which remain part of the fallback except for its reduced durations. Accordingly, neither complete level is satisfied. The existing financial warranty remains intact, and the Article 13 disclaimer expressly carves out warranties stated in that article.
